name: Passing the Blame
summary: A woman says the quilboar stole her gift and blames them for the garden's decline. She sends you north to the Valley of Bones to seek a quilboar of significance at Bristleback Retreat.

sections.title: A Garden in Peril
sections.body: A woman's garden is doomed to die, and she holds the quilboar responsible. She says they took her gift and sends you north into the Valley of Bones. At Bristleback Retreat, you are to seek out a quilboar of significance.

faq.q: Who says the quilboar stole her gift?
faq.answer: A woman says the quilboar took her gift and blames them for her garden's decline.
The woman sends you north into the Valley of Bones, to Bristleback Retreat.

faq.q: What am I looking for at Bristleback Retreat?
faq.answer: You are to seek out a quilboar of significance at Bristleback Retreat.

faq.q: Why does the woman blame the quilboar?
faq.answer: She says the quilboar stole her gift and are why her garden is doomed to die.
